spellbook.finance/limitations: One name can have dozens of printings. When more than one row matches, ask the person which set and collector number is physically in front of them. Never pick a row for them.
`hasMore` true means the result is a page, not a complete list. Narrow the query with a set code before paging.
A returned price is a catalog observation at its own timestamp, never a quote and never what a marketplace will pay today.
Language is an exact-printing fact. A Japanese row must not substitute for an English row with the same name, set or collector number.
This read creates no inventory. A printing existing here says nothing about whether the person owns a copy.

description: Find an exact card printing before recording a physical copy or forming a price. Searches by name, and narrows with `set:<code>` plus a collector number in the same query string, for example "Pikachu set:sv2a 025/165". Pokemon searches can filter English or Japanese catalog rows. Returns each printing with its product identity, game, language, set code, collector number, rarity and available finishes. Read this first, because a card name alone does not identify a printing, and a wrong printing values the wrong card.

game.description: Restrict the search to one game. Omit to search Magic, the default.

language.description: Restrict Pokemon results to English or Japanese catalog rows. Omit when language is unknown.

page.description: Page number of results, 1 to 20. Omit for the first page.

q.description: Card name to search, optionally narrowed with `set:<code>` plus a collector number in the same string, e.g. "sol ring set:c21 263". Required.

name: spellbook_printings_search
